privacy.title: Privacy & data
privacy.subtitle: Your data is yours. Export it, delete it, control how it's used.

principles.dataIsYoursDescription: Every record you create belongs to your account. We never sell or share it. You can export or delete everything at any time.
principles.noDarkPatternsDescription: MindStep never uses shame, streaks-as-threats, or anxiety hooks. Streaks celebrate effort; they never punish breaks.
principles.localFirstDescription: Phase 1 stores preferences and UI state in your browser. Synced data lives in your account, encrypted in transit.
principles.noPassphrasesDescription: MindStep never asks for or stores your Pi wallet passphrase. All Pi payments are verified via the Pi SDK server-side.
principles.strictOwnershipDescription: Every database query is scoped by userId. A user can never read or modify another user's records — enforced at the data layer, not the UI.
principles.calmByDesignDescription: No red dots of dread, no infinite scroll traps. MindStep shows what matters now and steps back.

dataRights.title: Your data rights
dataRights.description: What you can do with your MindStep data.
dataRights.export: Export all your data as a JSON archive.
dataRights.exportDescription: Download a complete copy of your data as a JSON file. Includes all tasks, projects, focus sessions, AI conversations, payment history, and more.
dataRights.delete: Permanently delete your account and all associated records.
dataRights.deleteDescription: This action is irreversible. All your data will be permanently deleted. You will be signed out immediately.
dataRights.withdrawConsentDescription: Sets all consent flags to off. Your data is preserved but features that require consent will be limited. To fully delete, use Delete Account above.
dataRights.aiRetentionDescription: Deletes all your AI conversations and messages. Your AI memories (preferences) are preserved.

center.title: Privacy Center

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.description: Permanently delete your account and ALL associated data. This includes every task, project, focus session, AI conversation, payment record, and preference. This action is IRREVERSIBLE.

dataSharing.title: Data sharing controls
dataSharing.description: Control what data MindStep can use for specific features. Turning these off may limit functionality.

dataSharing.note: Note: These controls are stored in your preferences. MindStep never sells your data to third parties.
